crossRefs.note: After him, Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of half the district of Beth Zur, made repairs to the place opposite…
I will wait for Yahweh, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.
Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in…
“ ‘Have you not heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it in ancient times? Now I have brought it to pass, that…
but now I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.’
At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said to him, “Because you have relied on the king of Syria…
“Yahweh who does it, Yahweh who forms it to establish it—Yahweh is his name, says:
‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’
But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.

translations.web: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who planed it long ago.
translations.bsb: You built a reservoir between the walls for the waters of the ancient pool, but you did not look to the One who made it, or consider Him who planned it long ago.
translations.kjv: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.
translations.asv: ye made also a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But ye looked not unto him that had done this, neither had ye respect unto him that purposed it long ago.
